Rodrigo "biguzera" Bittencourt (born February 18, 1997) is a Brazilian professional Counter-Strike 2 player who currently plays for paiN Gaming and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player from Niterói.

[edit]

  • Show All
  • 2020-01-22 |  CS:GO: de mudança para o Canadá com a paiN, biguzera critica treinos no Brasil: "Está muito difícil evoluir aqui" [CS:GO: moving to Canada with paiN, biguzera criticizes training in Brazil: "It's very difficult to evolve here"] by Roque Marques of Globo eSports
  • 2022-07-05 | biguzera: "Over there [in NA], I practice for one month and I learn 10% of that if I play here for one week." by Slevo of Dust2.us at Intel Extreme Masters XVII - Cologne
  • 2024-08-23 |  «ZywOo лучше, чем s1mple, как тиммейт и как человек» — интервью с капитаном paiN Gaming о его карьере, фаворитах BetBoom Dacha и бразильских болельщиках [«ZywOo is better than s1mple as a teammate and as a person» — Interview with the paiN Gaming captain about his career, BetBoom Dacha favorites and Brazilian fans] by LexMum of Cybersport.ru at BetBoom Dacha Belgrade 2024 #2
  • 2025-09-24 | biguzera про VRS: «Для меня несправедливо, что чемпион Fragaldephia зарабатывает больше очков, чем победитель мейджора» [biguzera about VRS: "It's unfair to me that the Fragaldephia champion earns more points than the major winner"] by Gleb Brekhov of OFFSTAGE at FISSURE Playground #2
  • 2025-10-12 |  biguzera：我认为我们的打法更加接近欧洲队伍 [biguzera: I think our style of play is closer to European teams] by 完美世界电竞记者团 and YINXING of Perfect World at CS Asia Championships 2025
  • 2025-11-13 |  biguzera: 现在我们的战队拥有最合适的角色分配 整体也更加平衡了 [biguzera: Our team now has the most suitable role distribution, and the overall balance has improved] by 完美世界电竞记者团 and YINXING of Perfect World at BLAST Rivals Fall 2025
  • 2025-11-14 |  biguzera: 这场胜利证明了我们同样能够在大型赛事的场馆中竞争 [biguzera: This win shows that we're fully capable of competing in the venue of a big event] by 完美世界电竞记者团 and YINXING of Perfect World at BLAST Rivals Fall 2025
  • 2026-08-28 | biguzera: "I feel as a team we don't trust each other anymore" by King Dempz of HLTV at BLAST Open Fall 2026
